Abstract
This independent experiment evaluates laser exposure condition and porosity in LPBF Ti-6Al-4V.

Materials and Methods
Ti-6Al-4V coupons were fabricated by LPBF and retained in the as-built state. Porosity was measured by X-ray computed tomography.

Results
For the as-built sample state, changing laser exposure condition from low exposure to high exposure decreased porosity from 1.9% to 0.7% in Ti-6Al-4V measured by X-ray computed tomography.

Conclusions
The second experiment also associated higher laser exposure with lower porosity in the tested as-built coupons.
